arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا.
transliteration: Bismillaah. Allahumma jannibnash-shaytaan, wa jannibish-shaytaana maa razaqtanaa.
translation: In the Name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from that which You provide for us.
